# Komainu Statue

- Creator: Zgon
- Source:
  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/komainu-statue-a5d4791ae95d4a9d9becedab6d2c7fc2

- SHA-256:
  `ee512df089e58f79e8993d2d593e197ef93847482ffcd288cb1d6bf1bdb5dfb9`

The source contains two symmetric komainu meshes, their two stele meshes, and
stone/moss PBR material variants. The shrine generator uses the two guardian
meshes, applies the moss material to both, scales packed textures to at most
512 px inside the generated `.blend`, and preserves this untouched 1K GLB for
reproducibility.
